input.title: Pick a hosting plan for the team
input.brief:
1. Open https://hosting.example.com/billing signed in as bea@example.com.
2. Choose either the Pro plan ($20 a month, 3 sites) or the Team plan ($50 a month, 10 sites), whichever you think fits.
3. Press Subscribe.
